resolution.note: Composer-only fixture adopts with the nine PHP records and drift reports 0 (test/adopt/adopt.test.ts)

title: Composer-only PHP repositories are adopted with the PHP records column
body:
Why: Fable 1115f slice 1; src/adopt/adopt.ts seeds by detectStack, so a composer.json repo without PHPUnit misses the PHP column.
Outcome: the adoption seed takes its stack from repositoryFacts.
Files: src/adopt/adopt.ts and its test.
Proof: a fixture with composer.json and no PHPUnit seeds the nine PHP records and drift reports 0.
